product.title: Fushimi Inari Hidden Hiking Tour

description.text: In Kyoto, this guided three-hour hike leaves the paved Fushimi Inari-taisha corridor for forest trails, a bamboo stand, a small shrine off the usual tourist path, and a viewpoint toward Fushimi-Momoyama Castle. A guide handles routing so the group can stay on unpaved approaches rather than only the lowest torii tunnel. The published window is about three hours on mixed forest and shrine paths. The format suits visitors who want a guided hike at the shrine without assembling a self-guided mountain loop. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Kyoto, and the itinerary stays on Fushimi Inari-taisha, the bamboo-forest trail, and the Fushimi-Momoyama Castle viewpoint that define this outing rather than an Arashiyama bike add-on.

highlights: Guided three-hour hike around Fushimi Inari-taisha
Forest trails instead of only the paved torii corridor
Small-shrine stop off the usual tourist trail

end.description: Return to your Kyoto meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
